pages.title: Denji in Chainsaw Man Hybrid Form Coloring Page
pages.description: Denji appears in Chainsaw Man hybrid form in this printable coloring page, with a long head blade and two arm chainsaws extending from rolled sleeves. His loose tie, belt, trouser folds, and lace-up boots add smaller enclosed details around the broad clothing areas of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pochita the Smiling Chainsaw Devil Coloring Page
pages.description: Pochita stands on four short legs in this printable coloring page, showing his forehead chainsaw, rounded back handle, open mouth, and curved pull-cord tail. Thick contours separate the broad body from the blade teeth and small paw details. The coloring sheet keeps the surrounding space clear.

pages.title: Power Holding Her Giant Blood Hammer Coloring Page
pages.description: Power grips a giant blood hammer in this printable coloring page, with her small horns, long hair, loose tie, and open jacket clearly visible. Both hands wrap around the continuous handle, which crosses her body diagonally. Her rolled trouser cuffs, sneakers, and the hammer's irregular head distinguish the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Makima in Her Public Safety Suit Coloring Page
pages.description: Makima stands in her Public Safety outfit in this printable coloring page, wearing a long coat, straight tie, fitted trousers, and a single thick braid. One hand rests in a pocket while the other hangs beside her coat. Buttons, lapels, hair sections, and low shoes define the character coloring sheet.

pages.title: Aki Hayakawa Drawing His Katana Coloring Page
pages.description: Aki Hayakawa draws his katana in this printable coloring page, holding the sword hilt in one hand and supporting its long scabbard with the other. His topknot, collared shirt, tie, and open coat identify the Devil Hunter. Blade edges, cuff folds, and lace-up shoes add smaller shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Reze Wearing Her Cafe Apron and Blouse Coloring Page
pages.description: Reze wears a cafe apron over a collared blouse in this printable coloring page, with her short tied-back hair, choker, and relaxed standing pose. The apron has a waist tie and a large front pocket. Rolled sleeves, the apron hem, socks, and simple shoes provide distinct sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Denji Hugging His Companion Pochita Coloring Page
pages.description: Human Denji hugs Pochita against his chest in this printable coloring page, supporting the small Chainsaw Devil with one forearm while wrapping his other hand around him. Pochita's paws, forehead blade, back handle, and pull cord remain visible. Denji's spiky hair, loose tie, and rolled sleeve frame the close character coloring sheet.

pages.title: Power Gently Holding Her Cat Meowy Coloring Page
pages.description: Power cradles her cat Meowy in this printable coloring page, supporting his lower body with one hand while the other rests across his chest. Her horns, long hair, open jacket, and tie surround the cat's raised paws and curved tail. Broad trouser panels and smaller shoelace details complete the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Aki Hayakawa Summoning the Fox Devil Coloring Page
pages.description: Aki Hayakawa makes the Kon hand gesture in this printable coloring page, with the Fox Devil's enormous head appearing behind his suit and topknot. Pointed ears, facial markings, a long muzzle, and sharp teeth dominate the upper composition. His sheathed sword, belt, and shoes add smaller details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Denji Pulling the Cord on His Chest Coloring Page
pages.description: Denji pulls the cord attached to his chest in this printable coloring page, raising one bent arm while his other hand hangs beside his trousers. His open collar, loose tie, belt, and rolled sleeves frame the handle and cord. Small Pochita stands near his shoe on the street-themed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Denji in an Eyepatch and Patched Jacket Coloring Page
pages.description: Denji wears an eyepatch and a patched casual jacket in this printable coloring page, standing beside Pochita with his hands relaxed near his trouser pockets. Stitched patches, torn fabric edges, and lace-up shoes distinguish his older outfit. A wooden shack, barrel, and scattered plants give the coloring sheet a sparse outdoor setting.

pages.title: Denji Sharing a Slice of Bread with Pochita Coloring Page
pages.description: Denji offers Pochita a slice of bread in this printable coloring page, sitting on a wooden crate in his eyepatch, patched jacket, and worn trousers. Pochita reaches toward the bread beneath his small forehead chainsaw. Plank walls, a shelf, bent knees, and detailed sneakers establish the compact shack scene on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Denji Cutting a Tree Trunk with Pochita Coloring Page
pages.description: Denji uses Pochita to cut a tree trunk in this printable coloring page, holding the Chainsaw Devil's back handle beside a log supported on a stump. His patched jacket, eyepatch, bent elbows, and planted shoes make the working pose clear. Wood rings, bark lines, and small grass tufts add detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Denji Eating Jam Toast at Aki's Apartment Coloring Page
pages.description: Denji lifts jam-covered toast toward his mouth in this printable coloring page, sitting at a table with a small plate and an unlabelled jam jar. His rolled sleeves, loose tie, pointed teeth, and spiky hair distinguish the close breakfast scene. The coloring sheet separates broad shirt panels from smaller fingers, buttons, and table details.

pages.title: Denji and Power Arguing by a Vending Machine Coloring Page
pages.description: Denji points toward Power beside a vending machine in this printable coloring page, while she answers with a raised fist and an open-mouthed expression. Her horns and long hair contrast with his spiky hairstyle and rolled sleeves. Bottle rows, buttons, trouser folds, and sneakers provide different enclosed areas throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Denji and Power Wearing Training Glasses Coloring Page
pages.description: Denji and Power wear rectangular glasses in this printable coloring page, standing near an apartment doorway as he touches his chin and she raises one finger. Their shirts, ties, trouser belts, and serious expressions define the training-themed pair. Clear arm positions and large clothing panels organize the character coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kishibe Holding a Devil Hunter Training Knife Coloring Page
pages.description: Kishibe holds a training knife in this printable coloring page, wearing his long coat, collared shirt, tie, and trousers with one hand tucked into a pocket. Short hair, facial scars, and stubble distinguish the older Devil Hunter. The blade, wrapped grip, coat buttons, and shoes form smaller details across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Himeno Wearing Her Eyepatch and Hunter Suit Coloring Page
pages.description: Himeno stands in her Devil Hunter suit in this printable coloring page, with short hair, a single eyepatch, a straight tie, and one hand in her pocket. Her other arm rests beside the jacket, leaving the pose uncluttered. Lapels, cuffs, trouser folds, and lace-up shoes divide the figure into clear sections in the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Himeno Summoning the Ghost Devil's Hand Coloring Page
pages.description: Himeno summons a giant Ghost Devil hand in this printable coloring page, extending her own hand while the separate clawed fingers rise beside her suited figure. Her short hair and eyepatch remain visible beneath the larger shape. Curving spectral lines, jacket seams, trousers, and shoes distinguish the human and supernatural parts of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Aki Hayakawa and Himeno Walking on Patrol Coloring Page
pages.description: Aki Hayakawa and Himeno walk side by side in this printable coloring page, wearing their Devil Hunter suits with relaxed arms and alternating steps along a city street. Aki's topknot and sheathed sword contrast with Himeno's short hair and eyepatch. Distant buildings and a slender tower add a light background to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Aki Hayakawa Preparing His Morning Coffee Coloring Page
pages.description: Aki Hayakawa prepares coffee in this printable coloring page, pouring from a curved-spout kettle into a mug while his other hand rests on the kitchen counter. His topknot, collared shirt, rolled sleeves, and trousers remain clearly outlined. A window, cabinet handles, and simple counter edges establish the apartment setting of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kobeni Higashiyama in Her Devil Hunter Suit Coloring Page
pages.description: Kobeni Higashiyama stands in her Devil Hunter suit in this printable coloring page, with tied-back hair, two hair clips, a small sweat drop, and a nervous smile. Her hands rest beside the jacket rather than holding any equipment. The tie, cuffs, belt, trouser seams, and shoes define the full character coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kobeni and the Violence Fiend's Ice Cream Coloring Page
pages.description: Kobeni and the Violence Fiend take an ice cream break in this printable coloring page, sitting together on a bench with one cone in each hand. Kobeni wears her suit and hair clips, while Galgali keeps his beaked mask and hood on. Bench slats, sleeves, trouser folds, and sneakers add details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angel Devil with His Halo and Feathered Wings Coloring Page
pages.description: Angel Devil stands beneath a circular halo in this printable coloring page, with shoulder-length hair and two large feathered wings spreading behind his shirt, tie, and jacket. His arms rest naturally beside his trousers, keeping the full figure easy to distinguish. Layered feathers, cuffs, lapels, and shoes create varied sections in the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Aki Hayakawa and Angel Devil on Patrol Coloring Page
pages.description: Aki Hayakawa walks beside Angel Devil in this printable coloring page, carrying his sheathed sword while his companion's halo and folded wings remain clearly visible. Their shirts, ties, trousers, and alternating steps distinguish the two figures. Street rails, a lamp, and simple building edges provide a lighter background for the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Beam in His Humanoid Shark Fiend Form Coloring Page
pages.description: Beam opens his arms in Shark Fiend form in this printable coloring page, with a shark snout above his face and a large dorsal fin overhead. His open shirt, trousers, toothy grin, and spread hands define the humanoid figure. Broad clothing areas and smaller fingers, seams, and shoelaces fill the character coloring sheet.

pages.title: Chainsaw Man Denji Riding Beam's Shark Form Coloring Page
pages.description: Denji rides Beam's full shark form in this printable coloring page, raising his arm chainsaws above the creature's rows of teeth, dorsal fins, and long fin-like legs. Three eyes appear along the visible side of the shark's head. Denji's bent legs, boots, loose tie, and head blade complete the action coloring sheet.

pages.title: Violence Fiend Wearing His Beaked Mask Coloring Page
pages.description: The Violence Fiend stands in his beaked mask in this printable coloring page, wearing a zipped hoodie, drawstrings, loose trousers, and lace-up sneakers beneath the covered head. Circular mask lenses and a stitched beak distinguish Galgali's silhouette. Relaxed hands, sleeve folds, pockets, and broad fabric panels organize the solo character coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princi the Spider Devil with Eight Legs Coloring Page
pages.description: Princi appears as the Spider Devil in this printable coloring page, with a closed facial zipper, long hair, a bow-tied blouse, and eight pointed legs beneath her skirt. Her two human arms hang beside the outfit while the spider legs fan outward. Curved joints, scythe-like tips, and pleated fabric distinguish the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Akane Sawatari Summoning the Snake Devil Coloring Page
pages.description: Akane Sawatari raises one hand in this printable coloring page, summoning the Snake Devil behind her hoodie, shorts, and sneakers with a broad curving serpent body. Its open mouth, long fangs, forked tongue, and overlapping scales frame the smaller figure. Clear fingers, clothing seams, and coiled shapes provide varied areas on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Katana Man in His Three-Bladed Hybrid Form Coloring Page
pages.description: Katana Man stands in hybrid form in this printable coloring page, with one long head blade and two forearm swords extending beside his open coat and trousers. His cap-like mechanical head, tooth-lined face, cuffs, and relaxed hands remain distinct. Broad coat panels contrast with smaller buttons, blade edges, and shoe details throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Makima Performing Her Kyoto Shrine Ritual Coloring Page
pages.description: Makima clasps her hands during the Kyoto shrine ritual in this printable coloring page, wearing a long robe with a tied sash and her distinctive braid. A torii gate and shallow steps stand behind her complete figure. Interlaced fingers, wide sleeves, long fabric folds, and sandals supply the main details of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Denji and Reze Sheltering in a Phone Booth Coloring Page
pages.description: Denji and Reze shelter inside a telephone booth in this printable coloring page, smiling at each other while rain lines and small puddles appear outside. His shirt and tie contrast with her blouse, skirt, choker, and tied-back hair. Glass panels, a telephone receiver, its coiled cord, and complete shoes distinguish the scene coloring sheet.

pages.title: Reze Pulling the Ring on Her Choker Coloring Page
pages.description: Reze pulls the small ring attached to her choker in this printable coloring page, holding it between her fingers beside her short tied-back hair and buttoned blouse. The pin forms a clear connection between the ring and collar. Her pleated skirt, relaxed other hand, socks, and lace-up shoes complete the character coloring sheet.

pages.title: Reze in Her Armored Bomb Devil Hybrid Form Coloring Page
pages.description: Reze stands in Bomb Devil hybrid form in this printable coloring page, wearing torpedo-shaped headgear, strapped explosive armor, forearm devices, shorts, and tall lace-up boots. Fin-shaped projections and pointed teeth distinguish the unusual head, while her hands rest beside the armor. Buckles, cylindrical shapes, clothing seams, and boot laces divide the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Denji and Reze Watching Festival Fireworks Coloring Page
pages.description: Denji and Reze watch festival fireworks in this printable coloring page, standing beneath hanging lanterns with their heads raised toward bursts drawn across the open sky. His loose tie and trousers contrast with her blouse, skirt, and choker. Their relaxed arms, simple shoes, lantern bands, and outlined firework trails provide distinct details throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Future Devil Dancing on His Tree-Like Roots Coloring Page
pages.description: The Future Devil raises both arms in this printable coloring page, swaying his tree-like body above spreading roots with antler-shaped branches extending from his head. Multiple facial eyes and one large eye within the torso distinguish the creature. Trailing vines, curved fingers, bark lines, and white root interiors shape the supernatural coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fox Devil with Giant Ears and Pointed Teeth Coloring Page
pages.description: The Fox Devil fills this printable coloring page with huge pointed ears, several eyes, a long muzzle, and an open mouth lined with sharp teeth. Layered fur outlines surround the head and upper neck without adding a full body. Broad white facial areas sit between smaller teeth and fur points on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Bat Devil Spreading His Clawed Winged Arms Coloring Page
pages.description: The Bat Devil spreads his winged arms in this printable coloring page, raising two clawed hands above a furry torso, pointed ears, and a wide fanged mouth. Membranes connect the arms to his body while two taloned feet support the stance. Fur tufts, wing sections, curved claws, and teeth distinguish the monster coloring sheet.

pages.title: Chainsaw Man Denji Facing the Giant Bat Devil Coloring Page
pages.description: Denji confronts the giant Bat Devil in this printable coloring page, standing in the foreground with three chainsaws while the larger creature spreads its clawed hands behind him. Wing membranes connect the devil's arms to its torso, and its taloned feet remain visible. Denji's tie, bent knees, boots, and simple street buildings complete the action coloring sheet.

pages.title: Ghost Devil with Flowers and Eight Hands Coloring Page
pages.description: The Ghost Devil appears in this printable coloring page with a smiling face, closed stitched-looking eyelids, long hair, and a narrow flower-covered body above eight arms. Open hands and curled fists fan out along both sides instead of legs. Individual petals, continuous arm shapes, fingers, and flowing hair sections organize the character coloring sheet.

pages.title: Denji, Power, Aki, and Makima Group Portrait Coloring Page
pages.description: Denji, Power, Aki Hayakawa, and Makima form a group in this printable coloring page, wearing Public Safety shirts, ties, jackets, and trousers in staggered standing positions. Spiky hair, horns, a topknot, and a long braid distinguish the four characters. Relaxed hands, pocketed arms, layered coat edges, and shoes provide details across the group coloring sheet.
